title: Karuthamma
desc: A woman, who lives in a village where female infanticide is a common practice, goes to great lengths to get justice when her sister and her newborn child are murdered in cold blood.

title: Uzhavan
desc: A young farmer is conscious of his looks and is unable to marry due to his insecurities. But a young woman teaches him that love is based on more than just physical attraction.

title: Colour Kanavugal
desc: A happy-go-lucky man falls head over heels for a girl from a wealthy family who rebuffs his sentiments. However, the man leaves no stone unturned to win her heart.

title: Mani Kuyil
desc: Kaveri records a video of Muthuvelu singing a song and sends it to a TV channel. Later, he becomes famous for his voice and falls in love with Kaveri.
